text:
lina: Quick heads-up — Violet Labs onboarding shows a sharp p95 latency regression after yesterday's model rollout. 95p ~2.6s (previous baseline ~1.1s). Theyre primarily short chat prompts with occasional long-context jobs. Proactive idea: run a 5% canary routing to a compact int4 variant, enable prefix cache for the short chat route, and tighten batching wait times. Need SE + SRE sign-off before changing routes.

mike: Can you drop the dashboard link and the token/endpoint breakdown? want p95 per endpoint and token distribution.

lina: Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/violetlabs/onboard-latency
lina: Summary: 78% short (<80 tokens), 20% medium (80-512), 2% long (>512). Spike coincides with increased concurrency from a new 3rd-party integration. Error rate steady.

ryan: Sounds like batching/throughput interaction with model size. Proposed steps: (1) Canary 5% -> redwood-compact-13b-int4, (2) enable prefix/KV cache for short chat route, (3) reduce max_batch_wait_ms for that route to keep latency predictable. Add auto-fallback if p95 worsens.

parth: Risk matrix: 
- Model swap: risk=low (possible semantic variance on corner cases). Mitigation=rolling canary + a 10-prompt eval set.
- Cache enablement: risk=medium (stale prefixes if they use dynamic system prompts). Mitigation=short TTL (30s) + instrumentation for mismatch rates.
- Batching tweaks: risk=medium (throughput pressure). Mitigation=enable burst autoscale and monitor queue lengths.

lina: Ill own the canary and customer comms. SEs (mike, ryan) — please prepare the route override config. Ill assemble the eval prompts.

mike: Draft route override below. Also recommend a tiny client-side retry to smooth transient tails.

```yaml
route: /v1/chat/completions
canary_percent: 5
model: redwood-compact-13b-int4
overrides:
  batching:
    max_batch_wait_ms: 6
    max_batch_tokens: 2048
  cache:
    prefix_cache: true
    ttl_ms: 30000
```

mike: Eval plan: 10 critical prompts covering their major flows. Monitor semantic similarity + task accuracy; abort if score drops >2%.

ryan: Ill add an autoscale guard on their Dedicated pool and a fallback policy: revert to original model on 3 consecutive p95 breaches. Deploy-bot, please schedule a 20-minute canary window starting 10:15 UTC.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: start=4991240400 (10:15 UTC), duration=20m, route=/v1/chat/completions, percent=5, owner=lina. Command: `/canary start --route /v1/chat/completions --model redwood-compact-13b-int4 --percent 5 --duration 20m`

lina: Ill notify Violet Labs: "Well run a 20-minute canary at 10:15 UTC to test a compact model + caching tweak; no downtime expected. Well share results and revert if anything regresses." Attaching eval set. :thumbsup:

mike: Ill monitor p50/p95, queue lengths, and the eval results. If anything looks off Ill flag here and well abort.

ryan: One ask — enable tracing on their top-3 endpoints for the canary so we can correlate KV cache hits and batching behavior.

lina: Tracing enabled for top-3 endpoints. Ill post canary outcomes within 30 minutes after completion: p50/p95, KV hit rates, eval deltas. Thanks all.
